definitions.explanation: A ball-shaped Japanese snack made from a wheat flour batter filled with diced octopus, cooked in a specially molded pan. Typically topped with sauce, mayonnaise, dried bonito flakes, and dried seaweed powder.

examples.japanese: たこ{焼|や}きを{食|た}べよう。
{大阪|おおさか}のたこ{焼|や}きは{本当|ほんとう}においしい。
{屋台|やたい}で{焼|や}きたてのたこ{焼|や}きを{買|か}って、ソースとマヨネーズをかけて{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I bought freshly cooked takoyaki from a street stall and ate it with sauce and mayonnaise.

notes: CULTURAL NOTES: Originating from {大阪|おおさか}, takoyaki is one of the most iconic Japanese street foods. Osaka residents take great pride in their takoyaki, and many households own a たこ{焼|や}き{器|き} (takoyaki maker). Common toppings include ソース (Worcestershire-style sauce), マヨネーズ, {鰹節|かつおぶし} (dried bonito flakes), and {青|あお}のり (dried seaweed powder).
